result.summary: Found 1 clear visual bug: a discount badge showing an invalid '-0%' value on the pizza card. Otherwise the page renders cleanly.

issues.description: The pizza card badge shows '-0%', which is not a valid discount value and looks like a data/formatting bug
issues.suggestion: Fix the discount calculation or hide the badge when the discount is zero

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel's third card (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge with no visual affordance indicating more content
issues.suggestion: This partial-card pattern is common, but adding a subtle edge fade or peek indicator could improve discoverability of scrollable content
